entities.name: Planar portal
entities.description: Artificial way to travel between planes without a planeswalker's spark.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: Demonic overlord of Duskmourn who generates wooden doors out of his domain.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: Invasion Tree created with tyrite that forcibly linked planes via Omenpaths.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: Paths opened across planes after the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: Post-Mending device with major limits on transporting organic matter.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Allied with New Phyrexia for a darksteel body.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Praetor who sent Vorinclex to Kaldheim for tyrite.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: Sent by Elesh Norn to Kaldheim to retrieve tyrite.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Plane later pocketed away into the Zhalfirin planar knot.

entities.name: Mending
entities.description: Event that stopped all artificial planar portals.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Entered Dominaria via the Stronghold portal during the Phyrexian Invasion.

events.summary: When the Mending occurred, all artificial planar portals stopped working.
events.quote: When the Mending occurred, all artificial planar portals stopped working.

events.summary: Tezzeret allies with New Phyrexia, letting the Praetors travel via the Planar Bridge.
events.quote: Tezzeret allied with New Phyrexia in exchange for a new darksteel body

events.summary: Elesh Norn sends Vorinclex to Kaldheim for tyrite used to create Realmbreaker.
events.quote: Elesh Norn sent Vorinclex to Kaldheim to retrieve tyrite

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, Omenpaths open across all planes.
events.quote: Omenpaths began opening across all the planes
